parts.subject: 國文
parts.title: 作文
parts.detail: 文言白話不拘，但段落要分明。

questions.stem: 下列成語用字，何者有誤？
「齧雪吞氈」一詞係指漢朝何人被匈奴單于囚禁於大窖中，不供應飲食，乃嚼雪混同氈毛而吞食？
陶淵明〈桃花源記〉：「晉太元中，武陵人，捕魚為業，『』溪行，忘路之遠近」，其中『』之字，下列何者正確？
左丘明〈燭之武退秦師〉一文，燭之武說服秦君退師的說詞中，最有影響力的選項是？

options.A: 若亡鄭而有益於君，敢以煩執事
options.B: 焉用亡鄭以陪鄰？鄰之厚，君之薄也
options.C: 舍鄭以為東道主，行李之往來，共其乏困，君亦無所害

questions.stem: 荀子〈勸學〉：「吾嘗終日而思矣，不如須臾之所學也」說明什麼道理？
諸葛亮〈出師表〉原文中，下列字詞何者有誤？
中國四大名著係指四部古典章回小說，下列何者有誤？
下列作品、作者對應，何者有誤？
蘇軾〈念奴嬌〉：「亂石崩雲，驚濤裂岸，卷起千堆雪。」文中「雪」指什麼？
〈岳陽樓記〉一文中說道：「而或長煙一空，皓月千里，浮光躍金，靜影沉璧。」是在描寫洞庭湖何時的景色？
方孝孺〈指喻〉一文的主旨：「天下之事，常發於至微，而終為大患；始以為不足治，而終至於不可為。」作者在說明什麼道理？
有關曹雪芹和〈紅樓夢〉敘述，下列何者有誤？

options.A: 曹雪芹祖先曾任江寧織造，家世顯赫
options.B: 曹雪芹祖父曹寅為著名的藏書家，並主持〈四庫全書〉的刻印
options.C: 〈紅樓夢〉初名〈石頭記〉，又名〈風月寶鑑〉、〈金陵十二釵〉等
options.D: 〈紅樓夢〉以富貴公子賈寶玉為視角，描繪了人生百態，展現人性美和悲劇美

questions.stem: 有關作家黃春明的敘述，下列何者有誤？

options.A: 一生漢詩創作不輟，有「臺灣新文學之父」之譽
options.B: 出生宜蘭，作品擅長描寫宜蘭平原農村小人物
options.C: 語言質樸親切，臺灣當代重要的鄉土文學
options.D: 小說作品有〈鑼〉、〈兒子的大玩偶〉等

questions.stem: 〈桃花源記〉：「遂與外人間隔。問今是何世？乃不知有漢，無論魏、晉！」此句意與下列何者相同？

options.A: 浮雲遊子意，落日故人情
options.B: 天生我材必有用，千金散盡還復來
options.C: 樹欲靜而風不止，子欲養而親不待
options.D: 山中無甲子，寒盡不知年

questions.stem: 顧炎武〈與友人書〉：「人之為學，不日進則日退。」可作為下列何種學習情況的註腳？
It’s not a surprising fact that education levels are _____ related to income.
The deadline was announced. The manager made us _____ our project proposal by next Monday.
Today’s news included the results of a study by Veterans General Hospital on the rise in alcoholism _____ the country.
Many smartphone manufacturers are developing user-friendly mobile devices with many features for a different _____ of the local market.
As the meeting is going to end in 15 minutes, the chairperson suggests we _____ the details and get to the last item on the agenda.
The HR manager _____ back from his business trip when we have our meeting next Monday.
You should _____ me to change lanes so that I could turn left at the intersection.
The representatives of two labor unions haven’t reached a consensus and _____ a solution after months of negotiation.
_____ other forms of energy, the cost of producing solar energy is relatively economical.
“What do you do for a living?” Choose the best response.

options.A: I live just a few blocks from here.
options.C: I used to work for an international trading company.
options.D: I’m a computer programmer in an IT company.

questions.stem: Some people think that using English is a way of _____ communication, so that people don’t have to negotiate which language they are going to use.
A lot of research shows that health problems _____ poor diet and a relative lack of exercise.
Too much sun damages the skin, _____ many people still do not use sunscreen.
All new employees enroll in an intensive English program designed to _____ the amount of time they are exposed to spoken English.
The team _____ all the best players you can find in this country.
Dian is so pleased to be informed of an opening in Taipei’s branch since she has been thinking of _____ 或 for a while. [D]
“Susan is all dressed up. I’d say she’s fishing for compliments.” What does the speaker think about Susan?
“Everyone, we’re just pulling in to our stop at Austin. We’ll be here for ten minutes to take on some more passengers.” Where is the speaker?
Since the files are regarded as strictly _____, you should save them with a password.
Interestingly, the painting on the wall is _____ upside down in that restaurant.
Any attempt to influence the referees during the game will be regarded as a(n) _____ of the rules.
The newly-appointed CEO is known not only for her integrity _____ for her decisiveness.
Don’t be troubled by Kate’s frequent angry remarks. It’s just _____ of her illness.
Everyone can be creative. Creativity is a tool we can all equip ourselves with and _____.
“Believe it or not, Fred’s new novel has been selling like hot cakes.” Choose the best explanation for the sentence.

options.B: Fred’s novel is about baking cakes.

questions.stem: Marc Chagall’s masterpieces are currently _____ at the national museum.
The best way to protect the skin _____ is to avoid the sun when it is at its hottest or wear sunscreen.
Being a good listener involves more than just the ability to speak. Your body language also _____.
General Motors announced yesterday that sales of its vehicles have increased _____ five percent over the last two years.
The success of our ad campaign for the new products _____ our expectation.
According to a recent survey, the amount of time _____ to leisure is dropping.
Audrey Hepburn will always be the favorite film actress of all time and a(n) _____ to style, elegance, and humanitarianism.
Pop art, _____ developed in the late 1950’s, is the 20th century art movement.
Only after I had arrived at the office _____ that I had forgotten to take the office keys with me.
_____, I think the conference has been a great success.
Long exposure to second-hand smoke can be _____ to anyone, particularly those who have never smoked before.
The company has _____ telemarketing as an effective means of seeking potential customers for years.
The government has decided to _____ the ban on the import of US beef until the end of next year.
All staff are required to _____ these new safety regulations.
“Who’s going to fill the position of Mike Andrews?” Choose the best response.

options.A: He should fill out the form first.
options.C: They’re considering an intern from the Marketing Department.
options.D: He went to the Accounting Department.
